46219a.title: Phase 1: Source-Aware SAST & Triage Subagent
46219a.description: Run semgrep, ast-grep, gitleaks/trufflehog, and trivy fs across backend, mobile, web-admin repositories to identify potential vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, and dependency CVEs.

061f37.title: Phase 2: Dynamic Execution & Endpoint Mapping Subagent
061f37.description: Start backend service or verify live execution paths, inspect API endpoints and routes in backend app.

b0a7b1.title: Phase 3: Targeted Vulnerability Discovery & Validation Subagents
b0a7b1.description: Spawn specialized subagents to validate authentication/JWT, authorization (IDOR/BFLA), input injection, file upload, and business logic vulnerabilities based on SAST findings.

d8510b.title: Phase 4: Vulnerability Reporting & Patch Verification
d8510b.description: Ensure all confirmed vulnerabilities are reported via create_vulnerability_report / create_dependency_report with inline code fixes and PoC evidence.

67e3f5.title: Phase 5: Attack Chaining & Scan Finalization
67e3f5.description: Review all filed reports, evaluate potential attack chains, and compile final executive assessment.
